comment_box: I strongly oppose this proposed ban. Veterans and their families deserve access to the full range of reproductive healthcare, including abortion. Abortion is medically necessary in cases of rape and incest, but also in many other situations — such as severe health risks, fetal anomalies incompatible with life, and mental health crises like PTSD. Veterans should not be forced to endure preventable suffering because of outdated politics. This proposal reflects a political agenda from the Trump administration, not the true mission of the VA. Veterans have earned comprehensive, compassionate healthcare — and they deserve nothing less.
